# Co-working space: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Fire evacuation drills must be recorded, per Safety Regulation 9. |
| C2 | Members' key-card logs must be erased after 30 days, under the Building Privacy Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a member, I want my door-entry history to vanish after a month so that nobody can trace my comings and goings.
US-2 As a member, I want to book a meeting room so that I have space for a client.
US-3 As a facilities manager, I want a record kept of every evacuation drill so that inspectors can see them.
US-4 As a member, I want to invite a guest so that they can enter the building.
constraints: Fire evacuation drills must be recorded, per Safety Regulation 9.
Members' key-card logs must be erased after 30 days, under the Building Privacy Code.
